name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_block
statement:
theorem sqrt_block (m k : Nat) :
    Nat.sqrt k = m ↔ m ^ 2 ≤ k ∧ k < (m + 1) ^ 2

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_const_on_block
statement:
theorem sqrt_const_on_block (m t : Nat)
    (h : t < 2 * m + 1) :
    Nat.sqrt (m ^ 2 + t) = m

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_eq_of_mem_block
statement:
theorem sqrt_eq_of_mem_block (m k : Nat)
    (h₁ : m ^ 2 ≤ k)
    (h₂ : k < (m + 1) ^ 2) :
    Nat.sqrt k = m

name: RoundedRootSums.blockSum_formula
statement:
theorem blockSum_formula (m : Nat) :
    blockSum m = m * (2 * m + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_Icc_split_succ
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_split_succ
    {α : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : ℕ → α)
    (a b : ℕ)
    (h : a ≤ b + 1) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc a (b + 1), f k =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc a b, f k) + f (b + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_squareBlock_iff
statement:
theorem mem_squareBlock_iff (m k : Nat) :
    k ∈ squareBlock m ↔
      m ^ 2 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 - 1

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_const_on_squareBlock
statement:
theorem sqrt_const_on_squareBlock
    (m t : Nat)
    (ht : t < 2 * m + 1) :
    Nat.sqrt (m ^ 2 + t) = m

name: RoundedRootSums.card_range
statement:
theorem card_range
    (n : Nat) :
    (Finset.range n).card = n

name: RoundedRootSums.six_mul_sum_squares_range_succ
statement:
theorem six_mul_sum_squares_range_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    6 * Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_const
statement:
theorem sum_const
    (n c : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun _ => c) = n * c

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_id_range
statement:
theorem sum_id_range
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i => i) =
      n * (n - 1) / 2

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_odd_range
statement:
theorem sum_odd_range
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun i => 2 * i + 1) =
      n ^ 2

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_Icc_eq_range
statement:
theorem sum_squares_Icc_eq_range
    (r : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 r)
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (r + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2)

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_Icc_one
statement:
theorem sum_squares_Icc_one
    (r : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 r)
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      r * (r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) / 6

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_range_closed
statement:
theorem sum_squares_range_closed
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) / 6

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_squares_range_succ
statement:
theorem sum_squares_range_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun i => i ^ 2) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun i => i ^ 2) + n ^ 2

name: RoundedRootSums.card_filter_product_eq_sum
statement:
theorem card_filter_product_eq_sum
    (A : Finset α)
    (B : Finset β)
    (P : α → β → Prop)
    [DecidableRel P] :
    ((A.product B).filter
        (fun p => P p.1 p.2)).card =
      Finset.sum A
        (fun a =>
          (B.filter (fun b => P a b)).card)

name: RoundedRootSums.card_filter_product_eq_sum_right
statement:
theorem card_filter_product_eq_sum_right
    (A : Finset α)
    (B : Finset β)
    (P : α → β → Prop)
    [DecidableRel P] :
    ((A.product B).filter
        (fun p => P p.1 p.2)).card =
      Finset.sum B
        (fun b =>
          (A.filter (fun a => P a b)).card)

name: RoundedRootSums.le_sqrt_iff_sq_le
statement:
theorem le_sqrt_iff_sq_le (m k : Nat) :
    m ≤ Nat.sqrt k ↔ m ^ 2 ≤ k

name: RoundedRootSums.reciprocalCount_formula
statement:
theorem reciprocalCount_formula
    (n m : Nat)
    (h : m ^ 2 ≤ n) :
    reciprocalCount n m = n - m ^ 2 + 1

name: RoundedRootSums.admissiblePairs_card_by_k
statement:
theorem admissiblePairs_card_by_k (n : Nat) :
    (admissiblePairs n).card =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun k =>
          ((Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n)).filter
            (fun m => m ^ 2 ≤ k + 1)).card)

name: RoundedRootSums.admissiblePairs_card_by_m
statement:
theorem admissiblePairs_card_by_m (n : Nat) :
    (admissiblePairs n).card =
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
        (fun m =>
          ((Finset.range n).filter
            (fun k => m ^ 2 ≤ k + 1)).card)

name: RoundedRootSums.admissiblePairs_card_by_reciprocalCount
statement:
theorem admissiblePairs_card_by_reciprocalCount (n : Nat) :
    (admissiblePairs n).card =
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
        (fun m => reciprocalCount n m)

name: RoundedRootSums.filtered_range_card_eq_reciprocalCount
statement:
theorem filtered_range_card_eq_reciprocalCount
    (n m : Nat)
    (hm_pos : 1 ≤ m)
    (hm : m ≤ rootIndex n) :
    ((Finset.range n).filter
      (fun k => m ^ 2 ≤ k + 1)).card =
      reciprocalCount n m

name: RoundedRootSums.card_Icc_one_sqrt
statement:
theorem card_Icc_one_sqrt (k : Nat) :
    (Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.sqrt k)).card = Nat.sqrt k

name: RoundedRootSums.reciprocal_root_identity
statement:
theorem reciprocal_root_identity (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
        (fun m => reciprocalCount n m)

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_as_filtered_cards
statement:
theorem rootSum_as_filtered_cards (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k =>
        ((Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n)).filter
          (fun m => m ^ 2 ≤ k + 1)).card)

name: RoundedRootSums.sq_le_implies_le_rootIndex
statement:
theorem sq_le_implies_le_rootIndex
    (m k n : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ n)
    (hm : m ^ 2 ≤ k) :
    m ≤ rootIndex n

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_as_filtered_card
statement:
theorem sqrt_as_filtered_card
    (k n : Nat)
    (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Nat.sqrt k =
      ((Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n)).filter
        (fun m => m ^ 2 ≤ k)).card

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_unfold
statement:
theorem rootSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (k + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_split_at
statement:
theorem rootSum_split_at
    (m n : Nat)
    (h : m ≤ n) :
    rootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range m)
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (k + 1)) +
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (n - m))
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (m + k + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.fullBlocks_formula
statement:
theorem fullBlocks_formula (m : Nat) :
    fullBlocks m =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range m)
        (fun j => j * (2 * j + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.lastBlock_formula
statement:
theorem lastBlock_formula (m n : Nat) :
    lastBlock m n = (n - m ^ 2 + 1) * m

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_closed_formula
statement:
theorem rootSum_closed_formula (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      rootIndex n * (n + 1) -
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (rootIndex n))
          (fun m => m ^ 2)

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem rootSum_explicit_formula (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      rootIndex n * (n + 1) -
        rootIndex n * (rootIndex n + 1) *
          (2 * rootIndex n + 1) / 6

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_before_square_eq_fullBlocks
statement:
theorem sum_before_square_eq_fullBlocks (m : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (m ^ 2 - 1))
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (k + 1)) =
      fullBlocks m

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_square_block_eq_blockSum
statement:
theorem sum_square_block_eq_blockSum (m : Nat) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range (2 * m + 1))
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt (m ^ 2 + k)) =
      blockSum m

name: RoundedRootSums.ceilRootSum_eq
statement:
theorem ceilRootSum_eq (n : Nat) :
    ceilRootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k => Nat.sqrt k) + n

name: RoundedRootSums.ceilRootSum_eq_rootSum
statement:
theorem ceilRootSum_eq_rootSum (n : Nat) :
    ceilRootSum n = rootSum (n - 1) + n

name: RoundedRootSums.ceilRootSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem ceilRootSum_explicit_formula (n : Nat) :
    ceilRootSum n =
      rootIndex (n - 1) * n -
        rootIndex (n - 1) * (rootIndex (n - 1) + 1) *
          (2 * rootIndex (n - 1) + 1) / 6
      + n

name: RoundedRootSums.ceilRootSum_unfold
statement:
theorem ceilRootSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    ceilRootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun k => Nat.sqrt k + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_step
statement:
theorem rootSum_step (n : Nat) :
    rootSum n =
      rootSum (n - 1) + Nat.sqrt n

name: RoundedRootSums.sum_range_split_sub
statement:
theorem sum_range_split_sub
    {α : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : Nat → α)
    (a n : Nat)
    (h : a ≤ n) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) f =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range a) f +
      Finset.sum (Finset.range (n - a))
        (fun k => f (a + k))

name: RoundedRootSums.rootSum_main_formula
statement:
theorem rootSum_main_formula
    (m n : Nat)
    (h₁ : m ^ 2 ≤ n)
    (h₂ : n < (m + 1) ^ 2) :
    rootSum n =
      fullBlocks m +
      lastBlock m n

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_roundedUpIndices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_roundedUpIndices_iff (n k : Nat) :
    k ∈ roundedUpIndices n ↔
      k < n ∧ roundsUp (k + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff
statement:
theorem mem_roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_iff
    (m r t : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    t ∈ roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r ↔
      t ≤ r ∧ m + 1 ≤ t

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff
statement:
theorem mem_roundedUpOffsets_iff (m t : Nat) :
    t ∈ roundedUpOffsets m ↔
      t < 2 * m + 1 ∧ m + 1 ≤ t

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonusSum_eq_card_roundedUpIndices
statement:
theorem nearestBonusSum_eq_card_roundedUpIndices (n : Nat) :
    nearestBonusSum n = (roundedUpIndices n).card

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonusSum_formula
statement:
theorem nearestBonusSum_formula (n : Nat) :
    nearestBonusSum n =
      Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
        (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonusSum_unfold
statement:
theorem nearestBonusSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    nearestBonusSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k => nearestBonus (k + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestBonus_eq_indicator
statement:
theorem nearestBonus_eq_indicator (k : Nat) :
    nearestBonus k =
      if roundsUp k then 1 else 0

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonus
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonus (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      rootSum n +
        Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
          (fun k => nearestBonus (k + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonusSum
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_bonusSum (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n = rootSum n + nearestBonusSum n

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_card
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_eq_rootSum_add_card (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      rootSum n + (roundedUpIndices n).card

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_explicit_formula
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_explicit_formula (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      Nat.sqrt n * (n + 1) -
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n + 1) *
          (2 * Nat.sqrt n + 1) / 6 +
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
        (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_formula
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_formula (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      rootSum n +
        Nat.sqrt n * (Nat.sqrt n - 1) / 2 +
        (n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 - Nat.sqrt n)

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestRootSum_unfold
statement:
theorem nearestRootSum_unfold (n : Nat) :
    nearestRootSum n =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
        (fun k => nearestSqrt (k + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_floor
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_floor
    (k : Nat)
    (h : 2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_floor_or_succ
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_floor_or_succ (k : Nat) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k ∨
      nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k + 1

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_sqrt_add_bonus
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_sqrt_add_bonus (k : Nat) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k + nearestBonus k

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_eq_succ
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_eq_succ
    (k : Nat)
    (h : ¬ 2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1) :
    nearestSqrt k = Nat.sqrt k + 1

name: RoundedRootSums.nearestSqrt_le_sqrt_add_one
statement:
theorem nearestSqrt_le_sqrt_add_one (k : Nat) :
    nearestSqrt k ≤ Nat.sqrt k + 1

name: RoundedRootSums.not_roundsUp_square
statement:
theorem not_roundsUp_square (m : Nat) :
    ¬ roundsUp (m ^ 2)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_add_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_add_card
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r)).card =
      (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card + (r - m)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_add_card_explicit
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_add_card_explicit
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r)).card =
      m * (m - 1) / 2 + (r - m)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_add_split
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_add_split
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2 + r) =
      roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2) ∪
        Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_card (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card =
      m * (m - 1) / 2

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_card_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_card_eq_sum_range (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range m) (fun k => k)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_succ_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_succ_card
    (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpIndices ((m + 1) ^ 2)).card =
      (roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2)).card + m

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpIndices_square_succ_split
statement:
theorem roundedUpIndices_square_succ_split
    (m : Nat) :
    roundedUpIndices ((m + 1) ^ 2) =
      roundedUpIndices (m ^ 2) ∪
        Finset.image
          (fun t => m ^ 2 + t - 1)
          (roundedUpOffsets m)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpOffsetsUpTo_card
    (m r : Nat)
    (hr : r ≤ 2 * m) :
    (roundedUpOffsetsUpTo m r).card = r - m

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpOffsets_card
statement:
theorem roundedUpOffsets_card (m : Nat) :
    (roundedUpOffsets m).card = m

name: RoundedRootSums.roundedUpOffsets_eq_Icc
statement:
theorem roundedUpOffsets_eq_Icc (m : Nat) :
    roundedUpOffsets m = Finset.Icc (m + 1) (2 * m)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_iff
statement:
theorem roundsUp_iff (k : Nat) :
    roundsUp k ↔
      ¬ (2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_not
statement:
theorem roundsUp_not (k : Nat) :
    ¬ roundsUp k ↔
      2 * k < 2 * Nat.sqrt k ^ 2 + 2 * Nat.sqrt k + 1

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_square_add_iff
statement:
theorem roundsUp_square_add_iff
    (m t : Nat)
    (ht : t ≤ 2 * m) :
    roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) ↔ m + 1 ≤ t

name: RoundedRootSums.roundsUp_square_add_iff'
statement:
theorem roundsUp_square_add_iff'
    (m t : Nat)
    (ht : t ≤ 2 * m) :
    roundsUp (m ^ 2 + t) =
      (m + 1 ≤ t)

name: RoundedRootSums.sqrt_le_nearestSqrt
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_nearestSqrt (k : Nat) :
    Nat.sqrt k ≤ nearestSqrt k

name: RoundedRootSums.mem_shiftedIncidencePairs_iff
statement:
theorem mem_shiftedIncidencePairs_iff
    (q a b n t m k : Nat) :
    (m, k) ∈ shiftedIncidencePairs q a b n t ↔
      m < t ∧
      1 ≤ k ∧
      k ≤ n ∧
      shiftedThresholdNat q a b (m + 1) ≤ k

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedCountSum_eq_inversionSum
statement:
theorem shiftedCountSum_eq_inversionSum
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedCountSum q a b n t =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedCountSum_eq_levelCountSum
statement:
theorem shiftedCountSum_eq_levelCountSum
    (q a b n t : Nat) :
    shiftedCountSum q a b n t =
      shiftedLevelCountSum q a b n t

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_succ
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_succ
    (q a b n t : Nat) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n (t + 1) =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t +
        (n + 1 - shiftedThresholdNat q a b (t + 1))

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevelCountSum_eq_inversionSum
statement:
theorem shiftedLevelCountSum_eq_inversionSum
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedLevelCountSum q a b n t =
      shiftedInversionSum q a b n t

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevelCount_eq_sum_indicator
statement:
theorem shiftedLevelCount_eq_sum_indicator
    (q a b k t : Nat) :
    shiftedLevelCount q a b k t =
      Finset.sum (Finset.range t) (fun m =>
        shiftedIncidenceIndicator q a b m k)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdCount_eq
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdCount_eq
    (q a b n m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    shiftedThresholdCount q a b n m =
      n + 1 - shiftedThresholdNat q a b m

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdCount_eq_sum_indicator
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdCount_eq_sum_indicator
    (q a b n m : Nat) :
    shiftedThresholdCount q a b n (m + 1) =
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k =>
        shiftedIncidenceIndicator q a b m k)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_cast
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_cast
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    (shiftedThresholdNat q a b m : Int) =
      shiftedThreshold q a b m

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_le_iff
    (q a b m k : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    shiftedThresholdNat q a b m ≤ k ↔
      (((m : Rat) - (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThresholdNat_pos
statement:
theorem shiftedThresholdNat_pos
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    0 < shiftedThresholdNat q a b m

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedThreshold_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedThreshold_nonneg
    (q a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ b * m) :
    0 ≤ shiftedThreshold q a b m

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedBase_nonneg
statement:
theorem shiftedBase_nonneg
    (a b m : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    (0 : Rat) ≤
      ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
        (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_add_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_add_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n t +
        shiftedThresholdSum q a b t =
      t * (n + 1)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_maxLevel
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_maxLevel
    (q a b n : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n
        (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n) =
      shiftedMaxLevel q a b n * (n + 1) -
        shiftedThresholdSum q a b
          (shiftedMaxLevel q a b n)

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedInversionSum_eq_mul_sub_thresholdSum_of_cutoff
    (q a b n t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b)
    (hcut : IsShiftedCutoff q a b n t) :
    shiftedInversionSum q a b n t =
      t * (n + 1) - shiftedThresholdSum q a b t

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedLevelCount_eq_powerCount
statement:
theorem shiftedLevelCount_eq_powerCount
    (q a b k t : Nat)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (ha : a < b) :
    shiftedLevelCount q a b k t =
      ((Finset.range t).filter (fun m =>
        ((((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) -
            (a : Rat) / (b : Rat)) ^ q) ≤ (k : Rat))).card

name: RoundedRootSums.shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff
statement:
theorem shiftedMaxLevel_isCutoff
    (q a b n : Nat)
